title: Practice 8: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я был ___ (послушный) ребёнком.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ребёнком»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tuna quickly became Japanese food.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «пищей»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Кот Тома всегда с ___ (недовольный) мордой терпит обнимашки Мэри.
exercises.prompt: Tom's cat always puts up with Mary's hugs with an unwilling expression on his face.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «мордой»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That branch is affiliated to the miners' union.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «профсоюзом»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Поезд прибыл с ___ (десятиминутный) опозданием.
exercises.prompt: The train arrived ten minutes late.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «опозданием»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
